source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.section: Rule Book III.D.11 (p.21); related III.B.1.e (p.14), III.E.1 (p.25)
source.quote_free_summary: The Skating System of score evaluation must be used in all NDCA Sanctioned events (Formation Teams and Team Matches may use a cumulative point system; Repechage call back is not permitted).

requirement: Results of an event that declares NDCA may be approved or published only through a scoring method verified for NDCA. None exists: ndca_skating is unavailable with no authoritative algorithm source. Declared NDCA events are blocked at approve and publish.
enforcement_point: Server actions approveRoundResultAction and publishRoundResultAction call guardRoundResultsForSanction before the database transition and refuse when blocked; the round results page and publicationControls mirror the refusal. App layer only: the database RPCs do not check the declaration (follow-up, needs SQL).

tests.name: OD-01 guard: every body x method x declaration combination

interpretation_notes: The rulebook requires the Skating System but does not define the algorithm in the supplied source: UNRESOLVED until an authoritative specification is independently verified. Scrutineer certification (III.B.1.e) and computer scrutineering files (III.E.1) are not implemented. effective_from is the edition month (June 2026), exact date not read from the PDF. The Formation Teams / Team Matches exception is not modelled. Not verified_compliant.
